profile: GNU Bash 5.3 Darwin C locale, native observations before implementation; virtual baseline is missing-feature evidence, not acceptance

cases.purpose: Initial stack and display modes; variable PWD is not the directory authority
cases.source: dirs; dirs -l; dirs -p; dirs -v; PWD=spoof; dirs -l; pwd

cases.purpose: Absolute push and later cd replace only the current-directory view
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'push=%s\n' $?; cd "$ROOT/b"; dirs -l; popd; printf 'pop=%s\n' $?; pwd

cases.purpose: Relative, spaces and Unicode directory operands
cases.source: pushd 'with space'; printf 'space=%s\n' $?; pushd '../ümlaut'; printf 'unicode=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: No-argument swap
cases.source: pushd a; pushd b; printf 'bad-relative=%s\n' $?; pushd "$ROOT/b"; pushd; printf 'swap=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Empty remembered stack and singleton displays/indexes
cases.source:
popd; printf 'pop=%s
' $?; pushd; printf 'swap=%s
' $?; dirs +0; dirs -0; dirs +1; printf 'index=%s
' $?; dirs -l

cases.purpose: Positive-index rotation
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a"; pushd "$ROOT/b"; pushd "$ROOT/c"; pushd +2; printf 'rotate=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Negative-index rotation
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a"; pushd "$ROOT/b"; pushd "$ROOT/c"; pushd -1; printf 'rotate=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Zero and last indexes including singleton rotation
cases.source:
pushd +0; printf 'singleton=%s
' $?; pushd "$ROOT/a"; pushd +0; printf 'leftzero=%s
' $?; pushd -0; printf 'rightzero=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: -n stores unvalidated relative and nonexistent entries without cd
cases.source:
pushd -n a; printf 'relative=%s
' $?; pushd -n absent; printf 'missing=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD"

cases.purpose: -n no-argument swap
cases.source: pushd -n a; pushd -n b; pushd -n; printf 'swap=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: -n rotations and index range relative to current directory
cases.source: pushd -n a; pushd -n b; pushd -n c; pushd -n +1; printf 'left=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pushd -n -0; printf 'right=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Default pop and OLDPWD/PWD updates
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a"; pushd "$ROOT/b"; popd; printf 'pop=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s\n' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD"

cases.purpose: Indexed non-top pops do not cd
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a"; pushd "$ROOT/b"; pushd "$ROOT/c"; popd +1; printf 'left=%s\n' $?; popd -0; printf 'right=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: -n pop zero/negative indexes
cases.source: pushd -n a; pushd -n b; pushd -n c; popd -n +0; printf 'zero=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; popd -n -0; printf 'last=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Display indexes and out-of-range error
cases.source: pushd -n a; pushd -n b; dirs +1; dirs -1; dirs -v +2; dirs -v -0; dirs +3; printf 'range=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp

cases.purpose: Clear keeps cwd and ignores or rejects other selectors according to oracle
cases.source: pushd -n a; pushd -n b; dirs -c; printf 'clear=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; dirs -cpv +9; printf 'combined=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Display flag bundles, -v/-p order, repeated flags and --
cases.source: pushd -n a; dirs -lpv; dirs -vp; dirs -pv; dirs -ll; dirs -- +1; printf 'marker=%s\n' $?

cases.purpose: Invalid options and dirs operands
cases.source:
dirs -z; printf 'dirs=%s
' $?; popd -z; printf 'pop=%s
' $?; pushd -z; printf 'push=%s
' $?; dirs word; printf 'word=%s
' $?; dirs -l

cases.purpose: Extra operands and options after operand
cases.source:
pushd "$ROOT/a" "$ROOT/b"; printf 'push-extra=%s
' $?; pushd -n a; popd +0 +1; printf 'pop-extra=%s
' $?; dirs +0 +1; printf 'dirs-extra=%s
' $?; pushd "$ROOT/c" -n; printf 'late-option=%s
' $?; dirs -lp

cases.purpose: Leading zeros, signed numeric overflow, malformed indexes
cases.source:
pushd -n a; pushd -n b; dirs +01; dirs -00; dirs +999999999999999999999999; printf 'overflow=%s
' $?; dirs +1x; printf 'malformed=%s
' $?; popd +999999999999999999999999; printf 'pop-overflow=%s
' $?; dirs -lp

cases.purpose: HOME abbreviation boundary, full paths, empty/unset/trailing slash HOME
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/home/one"; pushd "$ROOT/home-suffix"; dirs; dirs -l; HOME="$ROOT/home/"; dirs; HOME=; dirs; unset HOME; dirs

cases.purpose: CDPATH and pushd cd policy, separate current cd gap
cases.source: CDPATH="$ROOT/home"; pushd one; printf 'push=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; cd "$ROOT"; cd one; printf 'cd=%s\n' $?; pwd

cases.purpose: Logical symlink cwd and return through remembered spelling
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/link"; printf 'symlink=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; cd child; dirs -lp; popd; printf 'return=%s\n' $?; pwd

cases.purpose: Direct missing/file push failures preserve or mutate visible state
cases.source:
pushd "$ROOT/a"; pushd "$ROOT/absent"; printf 'missing=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pushd "$ROOT/file"; printf 'file=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD"

cases.purpose: Failed pop and rotation to nonexistent remembered entry
cases.source: pushd -n "$ROOT/a"; pushd -n "$ROOT/absent"; popd; printf 'pop=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pushd +1; printf 'rotate=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Failed no-argument swap and -n insertion of file
cases.source: pushd -n "$ROOT/absent"; pushd; printf 'swap=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pushd -n "$ROOT/file"; printf 'file-no-cd=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Readonly PWD ordering; selected stronger runtime protection is a policy decision
cases.source:
readonly PWD; pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'push=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD"; popd; printf 'pop=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Readonly OLDPWD ordering; do not remove readonly protections
cases.source:
readonly OLDPWD; pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'push=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; printf 'PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$PWD" "$OLDPWD"; cd "$ROOT/b"; printf 'cd=%s
' $?; pwd

cases.purpose: Pipeline/subshell/substitution state isolation
cases.source: pushd -n a; ( pushd -n b; dirs -lp ); dirs -lp; pushd -n c | cat; dirs -lp; out=$(pushd -n d; dirs -lp); printf 'sub=%s\n' "$out"; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Functions and brace groups share stack and cwd
cases.source: f() { pushd "$ROOT/a"; }; f; printf 'function=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; { pushd "$ROOT/b"; }; dirs -lp; popd; pwd

cases.purpose: Temporary HOME/PWD prefixes and readonly-free cd publication
cases.source:
HOME="$ROOT" pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'push=%s
' $?; dirs; printf 'HOME=%s PWD=%s OLD=%s
' "$HOME" "$PWD" "$OLDPWD"; PWD=spoof popd; printf 'pop=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; printf 'PWD=%s
' "$PWD"

cases.purpose: Explicit deferred DIRSTACK and tilde-stack scope; not requested implementation acceptance
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a"; printf 'tilde=%s:%s:%s\n' ~+ ~- ~+1; printf 'array=%s\n' "${DIRSTACK[1]}"; DIRSTACK[1]="$ROOT/b"; dirs -lp; pwd

cases.purpose: Option-like paths and marker behavior
cases.source:
pushd -- -dash; printf 'dash=%s
' $?; popd; pushd -- +1; printf 'numeric=%s
' $?; dirs -lp; popd -- +0; printf 'marker-pop=%s
' $?; dirs -lp

cases.purpose: Closed stdout error occurs after or before state publication
cases.source: pushd "$ROOT/a" 1>&-; printf 'closed-push=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd; popd 1>&-; printf 'closed-pop=%s\n' $?; dirs -lp; pwd
